name: multipliers-windows-unclamped
description: Monstera (let_top_dry, catalogue 7 days) in an 18 cm pot, watered on 2026-11-02: the start multiplier 1.2 makes the working interval 8 days (8.4 rounded), so the window is 2026-11-08 to 2026-11-12.
why: The start multipliers with the band for let_top_dry (25% early, 25% late): 7 x 1.2 = 8.4, rounded to 8 days; early 2 days, late 2 days; earliest 2026-11-02 + 8 - 2, latest + 8 + 2. Without the multiplier the window is [2026-11-07, 2026-11-11] (windows-assumed-margin). Hand computation.
